summary: Gone Augusta County lookout on a 3,894 ft summit; the association lists it as gone, and no source found covers its history or what remains today.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the tower as gone; its entry carries no register number.

evidence.quote: is one of the Summits in Augusta County, VA

evidence.supports: The summit is on the McDowell USGS topographic quadrangle
evidence.quote: and can be found on the McDowell USGS topographic quad map
approximate elevation is 3,894 feet (1,187 meters) above sea level

evidence.supports: The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists a tower on the knob as gone
evidence.quote: Augusta Signal Corps Knob 38.28909 -79.38708 Tower Gone

sources.title: Signal Corps Knob, Augusta County VA (McDowell Area)

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The sources reached give only a summit listing (elevation, quadrangle) and the association's county entry (tower gone, coordinates only). No build date, design, staffing, fire history or present-day condition was found, and the story is short because the evidence supports no more. The name's origin is not sourced, so it is not explained. Do not confuse this with Elliott Knob (Augusta County, 38.16650 -79.31407), about 15 km to the south-east, which the same association lists as a standing NHLR tower (US 87, VA 2).
